title: Algebraization of a supported formal module from completion on the closed subscheme
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, j:Z → X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and K a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on X. Suppose completion Coh(Z) → Coh(Z,K O_Z) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] is an equivalence. For any coherent formal module M on (X,K) annihilated by j.ker, there exists a coherent module G on Z [pqf-def-coherent] whose pushforward j_*G is coherent and whose completion is isomorphic to M. No properness or adic completeness is needed beyond the assumed completion equivalence.

proof.text: The closed-immersion formal equivalence lifts (M,hM) to its inverse image N on Z.
Essential surjectivity of the assumed equivalence supplies G and an isomorphism completion(G) ≅ N. This is an existential proof, not a definition by an unproved arbitrary witness.
Closed pushforward is finite and preserves coherence, giving hG.

Compose the completion comparison θ, termwise pushforward of the chosen algebraization isomorphism, the inverse evaluation comparison β, and the counit of the closed-immersion equivalence. Lift the resulting inverse-system isomorphism to the full subcategory of coherent formal modules.

theorem closedSupported_formal_algebraization
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (he : (@completion Z (isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType j) (K.comap j)).IsEquivalence)
    (M : CoherentFormalModule X K) (hM : SupportedOn K M j) :
    ∃ (G : CoherentModules Z)
      (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj G.obj)),
      Nonempty ((completion X K).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj G.obj, hG⟩ ≅ M)
